div.g-card.g-k-upcoming.html:
Undead Siege is back for Halloween The night mode returns on Oct 31 and runs to Nov 14. Survive five nights on Isolated with your squad: gather supplies by day, hold the line by night, and pull the Wonder Weapon from the lab before the final wave. Every night you clear pays out Siege Tokens, and the event store takes them for the Pumpkin Reaper blueprint, the Hollow calling card and a new Chrome Skull camo. What is new this year: two extra bosses on nights four and five, a revive totem you can build from scrap, and a harder Nightmare tier with its own leaderboard. The top 100 squads each week earn the animated Grave Keeper frame, and every squad that clears Nightmare once gets the Lantern emote. Rewards track: every 1,000 Siege Tokens unlocks a tier on the event track, and the last tier holds the Undead Siege weapon charm. Tokens carry over between nights but not past Nov 14, so spend them in the event store before it closes. Players who ran last year's Siege get 500 bonus tokens on their first night. Loadouts: the event plays best with high-capacity ARs and a shotgun for close calls. /loadout meta has the builds the top squads ran last year, and /gunsmiths search finds any build by name. Ammo boxes refill once per night, so bring a secondary that can stretch a magazine. Draws: the Hallowed Crate opens on Oct 31 alongside the event. /draw prices shows the full price table, including the discount on the first two pulls, and /draw calculator works out how much CP a full set would cost you before you spend anything. Clans: clan wars take a break for the two weeks of the event and resume on Nov 15. Clan tasks switch to Siege tasks, and clan chests pay out in Siege Tokens as well as the usual credits. Known issue: on some Android devices the night fog renders too dark on the lowest graphics setting. Raise the setting one step until the patch on Nov 3 fixes it. See you on the island — and keep the lights on.
